name: migration-guard
description: Makes Claude ask before it touches your database migrations or runs destructive SQL, with the risk and what it found.

mode.title: When to ask
mode.description: always: before every migration change. destructive-only: only when drops, truncates, type changes or risky commands (revert, reset, push, wipe...) show up. off: never ask (for a while, type /migration-guard off instead).

extraPathPattern.title: Extra migration path pattern
extraPathPattern.description: A regular expression for migration files the built-in rules miss, e.g. schema/changes/

extraCommandPattern.title: Extra migration command pattern
extraCommandPattern.description: A regular expression for migration commands the built-in rules miss, e.g. make db-up

keepHistory.title: Keep a history
keepHistory.description: on: remember each question and answer, shown by /migration-guard (kept by Claude Code, passwords masked). off: keep nothing.
